name: coding-agent-desktop
description: Electron + React desktop MVP for Coding Agent

scripts.dev: pnpm run build:electron && concurrently -k -n renderer,electron-ts,electron "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_GET_USE_PROXY=true VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: pnpm run build:electron && pnpm run build:renderer
